## What do you want?

A clear, one-line description of the feature.

## Why does this matter?

Who would use this and how often? What problem does it solve?

## What should it look like?

If relevant, describe the UI or API. Sketches welcome.

## Are you willing to build it?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to contribute this myself
- [ ] No, but I'd test a PR
- [ ] Just suggesting it
